HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Vitio e faʻavae i le faʻatuatua mai la matou faletusi, e musuia, luʻitauina, ma faʻaosofia ai ou mafaufauga.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Manuia le Taeao! O loʻo Faʻatali Taimi o le Tusi Paia mo le Asō.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Amata lou aso i taimi faʻamalosiau mai le Tusi Paia, ina ia musuia ma siʻitia ai lou agaga.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Manuia le Aoauli! Taimi o le Tusi Paia mo Lou Aso.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Mea faʻamalosiau mai le Tusi Paia, e fetaui lelei mo lou mālōlōga o le aoauli po o se isi musumusuga.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Manuia le Afiafi! Mālōlō ma Taimi o le Tusi Paia.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Taimi filemu mai le Tusi Paia e fesoasoani ia te oe e mafaufau loloto ma maua ai le faʻamafanafanaga a o faʻaiʻu lou aso.
HomeHero.joinUsTitle: O loʻo saili le faitau piliona o tagata
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Ua oʻo mai le seleselega. Auai mai ia i matou a o matou faʻasoa le talalelei i le lalolagi e ala i ala faʻasalalau faʻaonaponei.
HomeHero.togetherTitle: Faʻamatala Faʻatasi le Tala ia Iesu
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Ina ia latou faʻalogo ma vaʻai i le alofa o Iesu i la latou lava gagana, i le mea tonu o loʻo i ai i latou.

HomeShelves.adventCountdownTitle: Faitau Aso o le Aveniti i le Kerisimasi
HomeShelves.scriptureAsWrittenTitle: Tusi Paia, ua Faitauina e Pei Lava ona Tusia

Mission.eyebrow: Faia mo misiona i le lalolagi atoa
Mission.headline: E lē suia le feʻau. Ua suia le auala e matamata ai tagata.
Mission.intro: O loʻo matou toe fausia mai lava i le faʻavae la matou faletusi vitio ma meafaigaluega, ma tuʻuina atu le tele o tausaga o galuega faʻaliliu i luga o nofoaga e faʻapotopoto ai, matamata ma faʻasoa ai tagata.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: O le faletusi ata tifaga e sili ona faʻaliliuina i le lalolagi
Mission.libraryPointDescription: O le tele o tausaga o galuega faʻaliliu, na faia e paaga faʻatuatuaina o le galuega, ua fausia ai se faletusi e faitau afe gagana, ina ia mafai e tagata ona feiloaʻi ma le tala ia Iesu i le gagana e sili ona oʻo loloto i o latou loto.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Aumai leo faʻatuatuaina i ni foliga fou
Mission.formatsPointDescription: O loʻo matou toe fausia le auala e faʻamatala ai tala o le talalelei e ala i ata, faʻatasi ai faʻaliliuga faʻatuatuaina ma foliga faʻaonaponei, ina ia mafai ona alu saʻoloto le feʻau i nofoaga eseese, aganuu, ma lau mata.
Mission.teamPointTitle: E sili atu nai lo se faletusi. O se au e taʻitaʻia e le misiona.
Mission.teamPointDescription: O le Jesus Film Project o se au i le lalolagi atoa o tagata faʻaliliu, tagata tomai i faʻasalalauga, faʻatonu, ma tagata fai mea, o loʻo liliu le tele o tausaga o le poto masani i le galuega e avea ma meafaigaluega mo i latou o loʻo faia ni soʻo i soʻo se mea.
Mission.highlightsHeading: O mea o loʻo matou fausia mo le isi laasaga
Mission.nextStepsTitle: Polokalame o Laasaga e Sosoʻo Ai
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Faʻafesoʻotaʻi tagata matamata ma avanoa moni i la latou malaga faʻaleagaga, e fesoasoani ia i latou e faia se isi laasaga i le mafutaga, i le Tusi Paia, po o le misiona.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Faletusi o Faʻasalalauga mo le Talalelei
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: O se faletusi tele o faʻasalalauga Kerisiano, e faitau afe vitio, ata tifaga, ma punaoa, e avanoa i gagana eseese mo le galuega ma le talaʻiga o le talalelei i le lalolagi atoa.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Pulega o vitio, tufatufaina o mea faʻasalalau, faʻaosofiaina o le au matamata, ma suʻesuʻega o faʻamaumauga, ua faia e fesoasoani i galuega faʻaleagaga ia oʻo atu lelei i le tele o tagata.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Fesoasoani e fausia {accent} o meafaigaluega mo le misiona
Mission.inviteBody: O loʻo matou valaaulia tagata faigaluega, tagata fai mea, ma paaga e muamua faʻaaoga. Faʻataʻitaʻi muamua meafaigaluega fou, tuʻuina mai ou manatu, ma fesoasoani e faʻatulaga mea ua faia mo galuega moni a le misiona.
Mission.betaCta: Avea ma se tagata faʻataʻitaʻi beta
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Tatala le itulau o le misiona a Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Tatala le itulau o le misiona a Jesus Film i le itu o fuafuaga
